title: H Ghost Curated Falcon Token Corpus
subtitle: Public deduplicated uint16 train and validation streams for Falcon-H1
description: Public curated token streams only; no raw source text or source-document paths are included. Exact and conservative near duplicates are removed, severe extraction corruption and the credential dump are excluded, and source-document provenance remains local. The manifests record tokenizer identity, EOS placement, counts, hashes, and split construction. Source-document licensing is mixed or unknown.
